summary.text: Jim Abeler is a Republican state senator who has represented Minnesota Senate District 35 since February 2016 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A chiropractor, he previously served in the Minnesota House of Representatives from 1999 to 2015.

paragraphs.text: Jim Abeler attended Hamline University and the University of Minnesota, and earned a doctorate in chiropractic medicine from the Northwestern College of Chiropractic.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as a chiropractor, and says he is married with six children.
Abeler represented House District 35A from 1999 to 2015 and took office in the Senate on February 22, 2016.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a lifelong resident of Coon Rapids and Anoka who founded the PACT charter school and the Haven 4 Heroes veterans home in Anoka.
He said in that survey that he is passionate about independence and quality of life for people with disabilities and seniors, education at all ages, and health care quality, access and affordability.
